segments.name: Semiconductor Solutions
segments.description: Ultra-low power semiconductor solutions for edge AI compute in personal devices, medical, industrial, and smart home markets.
segments.evidence: We are a pioneer and leading provider of ultra-low power semiconductor solutions designed to address the significant power consumption challenges of general purpose and AI compute – especially at the edge.

revenueModel.text: Manufacturers purchase systems-on-chip semiconductor solutions through distributors and sales representatives for integration into edge AI devices.
revenueModel.evidence: We leverage our internal direct sales force and our global network of distributors and sales representatives to pursue and support our core end markets.
